# SVG Encoder · Moritz Vollmer

> A free browser-based developer tool by Moritz Vollmer for URL-encoding SVG markup and generating CSS background-image data URIs.

## Canonical Page

- https://svg.moritzvollmer.de/

## Function

Users paste SVG markup into the tool. It adds the SVG namespace when necessary, URL-encodes the markup, generates a CSS background-image data URI, displays an isolated preview, and provides copy actions for the generated values.

Processing takes place in the browser. The entered SVG markup is not sent to a server by the application.
